biography.value: Sprites are scouts and poison delivery systems. They shoot from concealment, apply poison conditions, and retreat before retaliation. Heart Sight makes them genuinely valuable as truth-detection assets — a summoner who needs to know whether an NPC is lying during a negotiation and has a Cooperative Sprite available has an advantage that most participants in the negotiation will not notice. Nature's Ally extends their intelligence-gathering to the natural environment. A summoner who understands what Sprites are good at will use them for information, not damage.

system.creatureSubtype: Fortune on saves vs charm effects
system.tactics: Sprites are excellent scouts and poison delivery systems. They rarely engage in melee, preferring to shoot from concealment. A Cooperative Sprite that has used Heart Sight can report back honestly on whether an NPC is trustworthy — one of the most genuinely useful things a low-tier summoner can get.
system.attacksNotes: Shortbow [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 5 + Ranged Combat 2), Range: 40/80 ft 1 success: 8 damage (3 + 5 Dex) + Fortitude [Easy] save or Poisoned (Weak) for 1 minute. (Short Range) 2 successes: 8 damage, DR halved (round up) + Fortitude [Easy] save or Poisoned (Weak) for 1 hour.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Heart Sight: Once per encounter, when the Sprite looks at a creature's eyes, it automatically discerns the creature's emotional state and whether it is lying. Will saves and Deception checks against the Sprite add 1 to both dice for creatures whose heart it has read. Nature's Ally: The Sprite can communicate with beasts and plants as if they share a language.
